pinyin: yī bào huán yī bào
literal: one · repayment · returns · one · repayment
natural: one repayment answers another

meaning.en: Good and bad deeds are each repaid in kind.
meaning.zh: 做了什么事，就得到相应的报应。

equivalents: tit for tat
what goes around comes around

examples.zh: 他欺负过别人，现在被人欺负，真是一报还一报。
examples.en: He bullied others and now he's bullied himself: what goes around comes around.

examples.zh: 一报还一报，这是他应得的。
examples.en: One repayment for another; he deserved it.

usage.en: Usually said of bad deeds coming back, sometimes of kindness.
usage.zh: 多指恶有恶报，有时也指善有善报。

pinyin: dīng shì dīng, mǎo shì mǎo
literal: tenon · is · tenon, mortise · is · mortise
natural: a tenon is a tenon and a mortise is a mortise

meaning.en: To be exact and strict, treating every matter by the rules and not blurring distinctions.
meaning.zh: 做事认真、一板一眼，不含糊、不马虎。

equivalents: to go by the book
to be strictly by the letter

examples.zh: 账目上丁是丁，卯是卯，一分钱都不能差。
examples.en: In accounts everything must be exact, not a penny out.

examples.zh: 他办事丁是丁，卯是卯，不讲人情。
examples.en: He does everything by the book, with no favours.

usage.en: Also written 钉是钉，铆是铆; describes a strict, precise approach.
usage.zh: 也写作“钉是钉，铆是铆”，形容认真严格。

pinyin: bái dāo zi jìn, hóng dāo zi chū
literal: white · knife · goes in, red · knife · comes out
natural: a white blade goes in and comes out red

meaning.en: A threat of violence, meaning to stab someone to death; used to show ruthlessness.
meaning.zh: 比喻用狠毒的手段杀人或威胁。

equivalents: to threaten to stab someone
a bloody threat

examples.zh: 他放狠话说白刀子进，红刀子出，谁也别想拦。
examples.en: He threatened violence, saying nobody could stop him.

examples.zh: 电影里的黑帮动不动就喊白刀子进，红刀子出。
examples.en: Gangsters in films keep shouting about spilling blood.

usage.en: A tough-guy line, mostly seen in fiction and dialect.
usage.zh: 狠话，多见于小说、方言和影视。

pinyin: shě mìng péi jūn zǐ
literal: give up · life · accompany · gentleman
natural: risk one's life to keep a gentleman company

meaning.en: To go along with a friend at great personal cost, often said jokingly (such as when drinking).
meaning.zh: 为了陪朋友，不惜付出很大代价（常用于开玩笑，如陪酒）。

equivalents: to go the extra mile for a friend
to sacrifice oneself for a friend's sake

examples.zh: 你想喝我陪你，舍命陪君子！
examples.en: If you want a drink I'll join you, whatever the cost!

examples.zh: 明知道会累，他还是舍命陪君子，陪我逛了一天。
examples.en: Though he knew it would be tiring, he shopped with me all day.

usage.en: Usually humorous, about socialising and drinking.
usage.zh: 多为玩笑口吻，常用于应酬、喝酒。

text: 蜀中无大将，廖化作先锋
pinyin: shǔ zhōng wú dà jiàng, liào huà zuò xiān fēng
literal: Shu · in · no · great · general, Liao Hua · act as · vanguard
natural: with no great generals in Shu, Liao Hua leads the vanguard

meaning.en: When there are no talented people left, mediocre ones get promoted.
meaning.zh: 没有杰出人才时，平庸的人也只能担当重任。

equivalents: in the land of the blind, the one-eyed man is king
when the cat's away

examples.zh: 蜀中无大将，廖化作先锋，现在队里只好让新人上了。
examples.en: With no stars left, the newcomers have to step up.

examples.zh: 公司骨干都走了，蜀中无大将，廖化作先锋。
examples.en: With the key staff gone, the second-raters have to take the lead.

usage.en: Often self-deprecating; refers to Liao Hua, a general of Shu Han in the Three Kingdoms.
usage.zh: 常带自嘲，廖化是三国蜀汉将领。

synonyms: 山中无老虎，猴子称大王

pinyin: nán ér xī xià yǒu huáng jīn
literal: man · knees · below · has · gold
natural: a man's knees are worth gold

meaning.en: A real man does not kneel or beg lightly; he keeps his dignity.
meaning.zh: 男子汉不轻易下跪求人，要有尊严。

equivalents: a man should not bow his head easily
to keep one's dignity

examples.zh: 男儿膝下有黄金，他宁愿失业也不向老板低头。
examples.en: He'd rather lose his job than bow to the boss.

examples.zh: 爸爸教我男儿膝下有黄金，不要随便求人。
examples.en: Dad taught me not to beg for favours easily.

usage.en: Traditional; usually followed by 不轻易下跪; nowadays 男人 is a common variant.
usage.zh: 传统说法，也说“男人膝下有黄金”。

pinyin: chéng shì bù zú, bài shì yǒu yú
literal: accomplish · matters · not · enough, spoil · matters · more than enough
natural: not enough to get things done, more than enough to spoil them

meaning.en: Unable to accomplish anything and quite capable of ruining it.
meaning.zh: 办不成事，却很容易把事情搞砸。

equivalents: too many cooks spoil the broth
more hindrance than help

examples.zh: 他成事不足，败事有余，还是别让他插手。
examples.en: He can't do anything right and only makes things worse; keep him out.

examples.zh: 这种人成事不足，败事有余，不能委以重任。
examples.en: Such a man is more of a hindrance; don't give him responsibility.

usage.en: Sharp criticism; often says 此人/这种人 first.
usage.zh: 批评的话，常用于指某人。

text: 秀才不出门，能知天下事
pinyin: xiù cái bù chū mén, néng zhī tiān xià shì
variants: 秀才不出门，全知天下事
literal: scholar · not · go out · door, can · know · world · affairs
natural: a scholar can know the affairs of the world without leaving home

meaning.en: A well-read person understands the world without going out.
meaning.zh: 读书人足不出户，也能知晓天下的事。

equivalents: a reader travels the world from his armchair
books bring the world to you

examples.zh: 秀才不出门，能知天下事，现在上网更是如此。
examples.en: A scholar needs not leave home to know the world, and now there's the internet.

examples.zh: 他爱读书，真是秀才不出门，能知天下事。
examples.en: He loves reading and knows what happens everywhere.

usage.en: Today often applied to the internet or news.
usage.zh: 今天常用来形容网络、新闻带来的便利。

pinyin: dǎ shì qīn, mà shì ài
literal: hit · is · affection, scold · is · love
natural: hitting is affection, scolding is love

meaning.en: Strict discipline is a sign of care; also said teasingly between lovers.
meaning.zh: 严厉管教是出于关爱；也用于情侣间打闹。

equivalents: spare the rod and spoil the child
to be cruel to be kind

examples.zh: 老话说打是亲，骂是爱，不过现在不提倡打孩子。
examples.en: The old saying has it that hitting is love, but we don't hit children now.

examples.zh: 他们俩打是亲，骂是爱，吵完马上就和好。
examples.en: They scold and tease each other out of love and make up at once.

usage.en: Now often playful; as advice on discipline it is increasingly criticised.
usage.zh: 今多为戏谑；用作管教理由时常受批评。

pinyin: gùn bàng dǐ xià chū xiào zǐ
literal: stick · rod · beneath · produces · filial · son
natural: dutiful sons come from under the rod

meaning.en: Strict, even physical, discipline raises good children.
meaning.zh: 对孩子严厉管教，才能培养出孝顺的孩子。

equivalents: spare the rod and spoil the child

examples.zh: 他爸总说棍棒底下出孝子，但他不赞同。
examples.en: His father always said children need the stick, but he disagrees.

examples.zh: 棍棒底下出孝子的观念已经受到质疑。
examples.en: The idea that harsh discipline produces dutiful children is now questioned.

usage.en: Traditional and now controversial; often quoted critically.
usage.zh: 传统说法，今天争议较大，常被批评性地引用。

pinyin: yán shī chū gāo tú
literal: strict · teacher · produces · excellent · pupil
natural: a strict teacher produces outstanding pupils

meaning.en: Demanding teachers bring out the best in their students.
meaning.zh: 要求严格的老师才能培养出优秀的学生。

equivalents: a strict teacher makes a fine student
no pain, no gain

examples.zh: 严师出高徒，这位教练对队员要求很高。
examples.en: A strict teacher makes top students; this coach is very demanding.

examples.zh: 感谢严师出高徒的教导，我才有今天。
examples.en: Thanks to my strict teacher, I am who I am today.

usage.en: Often used to thank or praise a strict teacher.
usage.zh: 常用来称赞、感谢严格的老师。

pinyin: yǎng bù jiào, fù zhī guò
literal: rear · not · teach, father's · fault
natural: to bring up a child without teaching him is the father's fault

meaning.en: If children are not taught properly, the parents are to blame.
meaning.zh: 只养育而不教导孩子，是父亲的过错。

equivalents: parents are to blame for a badly taught child
as the twig is bent, so grows the tree

examples.zh: 养不教，父之过，孩子犯错家长也有责任。
examples.en: If a child isn't taught, the parents are at fault; they share the blame.

examples.zh: 养不教，父之过，他的父亲很自责。
examples.en: The failure is the father's, he blamed himself.

story.en: The Three Character Classic says: 'To feed without teaching is the father's fault; teaching without strictness is the teacher's laziness.'
story.zh: 《三字经》：“养不教，父之过；教不严，师之惰。”

usage.en: Follows with 教不严，师之惰 in the original.
usage.zh: 原文下句为“教不严，师之惰”。

pinyin: cí mǔ duō bài ér
literal: kind · mother · many · ruin · sons
natural: indulgent mothers often ruin their sons

meaning.en: Over-indulgent parents tend to spoil their children.
meaning.zh: 过分溺爱孩子，往往会毁了孩子。

equivalents: spare the rod and spoil the child
spoilt by overindulgence

examples.zh: 慈母多败儿，别什么都依着孩子。
examples.en: Indulgent mothers spoil their sons; don't give in to the child's every wish.

examples.zh: 他从小被宠坏了，真是慈母多败儿。
examples.en: He was spoilt from childhood.

usage.en: A caution against over-protective parenting.
usage.zh: 用于告诫不要溺爱孩子。

text: 孩子是自己的好，老婆是别人的好
pinyin: hái zi shì zì jǐ de hǎo, lǎo po shì bié rén de hǎo
literal: child · is · one's own · good, wife · is · other people's · good
natural: one's own child is the best; someone else's wife looks better

meaning.en: People always think their own children are best and other people's wives are better.
meaning.zh: 人总觉得自己的孩子最好，别人的妻子更好。

equivalents: the grass is always greener on the other side

examples.zh: 孩子是自己的好，老婆是别人的好，这话虽调侃，也有几分道理。
examples.en: It's a joke, but there's some truth in it.

examples.zh: 别信什么孩子是自己的好，老婆是别人的好，珍惜眼前人。
examples.en: Don't believe that; cherish the one you have.

usage.en: A humorous, male-centred saying; some find it dated or offensive.
usage.zh: 半开玩笑，从男性视角出发，有人认为不妥。

pinyin: ér dà bù yóu niáng
literal: son · grown · not · follow · mother
natural: once a son has grown, he no longer obeys his mother

meaning.en: Grown-up children make their own decisions and no longer follow their parents.
meaning.zh: 孩子长大了就有自己的主意，不再听父母的。

equivalents: children grow up and go their own way
you can't hold on to a grown child

examples.zh: 儿大不由娘，他的婚事只能让他自己决定。
examples.en: Sons make up their own minds; he must decide his own marriage.

examples.zh: 儿大不由娘，妈妈也只能放手。
examples.en: Grown-up children go their own way; mother has to let go.

usage.en: Often a sigh from a parent; 女大不中留 is the daughter counterpart.
usage.zh: 多为父母的感叹，与“女大不中留”相对。

text: 嫁出去的女儿，泼出去的水
pinyin: jià chū qù de nǚ ér, pō chū qù de shuǐ
literal: married · out · daughter, spilt · out · water
natural: a married daughter is like spilt water

meaning.en: A daughter who has married belongs to another family and is no longer part of her parents' household (a traditional, now criticised attitude).
meaning.zh: 出嫁的女儿属于夫家，和娘家不再是一家人（旧观念，今多受批评）。

equivalents: a daughter once married is gone for good

examples.zh: 嫁出去的女儿，泼出去的水，这种观念早该淘汰了。
examples.en: That old idea of a daughter being spilt water should be discarded.

examples.zh: 奶奶以前常说嫁出去的女儿，泼出去的水。
examples.en: Grandma used to say a married daughter is spilt water.

usage.en: Mostly quoted to criticise gender bias.
usage.zh: 多用来批评重男轻女的旧观念。

antonyms: 女儿是爸爸的贴心小棉袄

pinyin: nǚ dà bù zhōng liú
literal: daughter · grown · not · fit · keep
natural: a grown daughter can't be kept at home

meaning.en: A grown-up daughter will want to marry and leave home.
meaning.zh: 女儿长大了就要出嫁，留不住。

equivalents: a grown daughter will soon fly the nest

examples.zh: 女大不中留，她已经有男朋友了。
examples.en: A grown daughter can't be kept; she already has a boyfriend.

examples.zh: 妈妈叹气说女大不中留。
examples.en: Mum sighed that a daughter can't be kept at home forever.

usage.en: Often said with affection and a little regret.
usage.zh: 语气带不舍，多为长辈所说。

pinyin: nǚ rén xīn, hǎi dǐ zhēn
literal: woman · heart, sea · bottom · needle
natural: a woman's heart is a needle at the bottom of the sea

meaning.en: Women's thoughts are hard to guess (a stereotyped, often humorous remark).
meaning.zh: 女人的心思难以捉摸。

equivalents: women are a mystery
to be as hard to read as the sea floor

examples.zh: 她刚才还好好的，现在又生气了，真是女人心，海底针。
examples.en: She was fine just now and now she's angry; a woman's heart is a needle in the sea.

examples.zh: 女人心，海底针，他怎么猜也猜不透。
examples.en: He could not guess what she thought.

usage.en: Humorous and stereotyped; best avoided in formal writing.
usage.zh: 带有刻板印象，多为戏谑，不宜用于正式场合。

text: 男怕入错行，女怕嫁错郎
pinyin: nán pà rù cuò háng, nǚ pà jià cuò láng
literal: man · fears · enter · wrong · trade, woman · fears · marry · wrong · husband
natural: men fear choosing the wrong trade, women fear marrying the wrong man

meaning.en: The big decisions of a career (for men) and marriage (for women) are the ones that shape life.
meaning.zh: 男人最怕选错职业，女人最怕嫁错丈夫。

equivalents: choose your career and spouse carefully

examples.zh: 男怕入错行，女怕嫁错郎，这两件事都要慎重。
examples.en: Both career and marriage need careful thought.

examples.zh: 她常说男怕入错行，女怕嫁错郎，所以选专业特别谨慎。
examples.en: She chose her major with great care.

usage.en: Traditional gender roles; today often used loosely about any big choice.
usage.zh: 带传统性别分工观念，今常泛指重大选择。

pinyin: jià hàn jià hàn, chuān yī chī fàn
literal: marry · man · marry · man, wear · clothes · eat · food
natural: to marry a man is to have clothes and food

meaning.en: Marriage was traditionally seen as a way to secure a living (an outdated view).
meaning.zh: 旧时认为女子出嫁就是为了有衣穿、有饭吃。

equivalents: marry for a meal ticket

examples.zh: 嫁汉嫁汉，穿衣吃饭，这种想法现在显得很落后。
examples.en: Marrying for a living now seems backward.

examples.zh: 嫁汉嫁汉，穿衣吃饭是老一辈的说法。
examples.en: The older generation said that marriage meant food and clothes.

usage.en: Describes pragmatic marriage in the old society; often quoted critically.
usage.zh: 形容旧社会女子的婚姻观，今多批评性引用。

text: 夫妻本是同林鸟，大难临头各自飞
pinyin: fū qī běn shì tóng lín niǎo, dà nàn lín tóu gè zì fēi
literal: husband · wife · originally · are · same · forest · birds, great · disaster · arrives · each · flies
natural: husband and wife are birds in one forest, but fly off alone when disaster strikes

meaning.en: Even couples abandon each other when real trouble comes.
meaning.zh: 夫妻在平时亲密，遇到大难时也会各自逃命。

equivalents: fair-weather friends in love
every man for himself

examples.zh: 夫妻本是同林鸟，大难临头各自飞，他们果然离婚了。
examples.en: In hard times even a couple scatters, and they did divorce.

examples.zh: 夫妻本是同林鸟，大难临头各自飞，这话听着太悲观了。
examples.en: That saying about couples fleeing in trouble sounds too gloomy.

usage.en: Cynical; usually quoted as a warning or complaint.
usage.zh: 带有消极意味，常作感叹。

pinyin: fū qī méi yǒu gé yè chóu
literal: husband · wife · no · overnight · grudge
natural: a couple holds no grudge overnight

meaning.en: Spouses quickly forgive and make up after quarrels.
meaning.zh: 夫妻吵架很快就会和好，不会记仇。

equivalents: never go to bed angry
a couple's quarrels don't last

examples.zh: 夫妻没有隔夜仇，睡一觉就好了。
examples.en: Couples don't hold grudges; a night's sleep will mend it.

examples.zh: 他们吵完架就和好了，真是夫妻没有隔夜仇。
examples.en: They made up right after the row, with no grudge overnight.

usage.en: A comforting remark about couples' quarrels.
usage.zh: 用来宽慰夫妻吵架。

pinyin: chuáng tóu chǎo jià chuáng wěi hé
literal: bed · head · quarrel, bed · foot · make peace
natural: quarrel at the head of the bed, make up at the foot

meaning.en: Quarrels between husband and wife are soon forgotten.
meaning.zh: 夫妻吵架，很快就会和好。

equivalents: lovers' quarrels are soon mended

examples.zh: 别担心他们，床头吵架床尾和。
examples.en: Don't worry about them; they'll make up soon.

examples.zh: 老人说床头吵架床尾和，让他们自己解决吧。
examples.en: The old folks say couples make up quickly; let them settle it.

usage.en: A comforting saying about couples' quarrels.
usage.zh: 常用来劝慰夫妻吵架。

pinyin: bǎi nián xiū de tóng chuán dù
literal: hundred · years · cultivate · get · same · boat · cross
natural: it takes a hundred years of merit to share a ferry

meaning.en: Even a chance meeting is the result of great fate (the full saying is 十年修得同船渡，百年修得共枕眠).
meaning.zh: 相遇是缘分，来之不易（完整说法为“十年修得同船渡，百年修得共枕眠”）。

equivalents: a chance meeting is fate
ships passing in the night

examples.zh: 百年修得同船渡，我们能做同事真是有缘。
examples.en: It takes merit to share a ferry; being colleagues is fate.

examples.zh: 百年修得同船渡，珍惜这次同行的缘分吧。
examples.en: Cherish this chance to travel together.

usage.en: Said about fate and affinity; commonly quoted in romance.
usage.zh: 多说缘分，常见于感情话题。

pinyin: qiǎng niǔ de guā bù tián
literal: force · twist · melon · not · sweet
natural: a melon twisted off by force is not sweet

meaning.en: Anything forced, especially love or marriage, will not turn out well.
meaning.zh: 勉强促成的事（尤其是感情）不会有好结果。

equivalents: you can't force love
you can lead a horse to water but you can't make it drink

examples.zh: 强扭的瓜不甜，既然她不愿意，就别勉强了。
examples.en: A forced melon is never sweet; since she doesn't want to, don't force her.

examples.zh: 强扭的瓜不甜，感情不能逼。
examples.en: You can't force love.

usage.en: Often said of love, but also of jobs, deals and any compulsion.
usage.zh: 多说感情，也可泛指一切勉强之事。
